audit_items.proof_trace: TOCTOU race: clock.CurrentSlot() (line 169) and clock.Now() (line 172) call time.Now() twice without atomicity. When system time crosses a slot boundary between these reads, currentSlot reflects slot N while now reflects slot N+1, causing the early-exit check (line 182-183) to incorrectly skip validation for slot N sidecars, and the future-slot check (line 195) to incorrectly accept slot N+1 sidecars that should be ignored.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker sends data column sidecar with slot=N at time just before slot boundary. First time.Now() reads slot N, time advances past boundary, second time.Now() is in slot N+1. Check currentSlot==dataColumnSlot matches (N==N), triggering continue at line 183, bypassing all future-slot validation. Sidecar from previous slot accepted without time verification. Alternatively, sidecar with slot=N+1 passes earliestStart check due to inconsistent time reads.
